hook.text: 作为博主网红美食师工作，但镜头一关，简单重复才是生活。今天是我想做，却一直不敢做的主题，人生家常菜……

content_format.presentation_style: Fast-paced, humorous, practical ASMR cooking demonstration with voiceover

structure.purpose: Establish creator credibility and address the anxiety of cooking basic dishes.
Teach the ultimate comfort food with tips on rich soup and fluffy eggs.
Showcase high-heat technique for simple greens.
Demonstrate knife skills and fast stir-frying for crisp texture.
Provide the exact water-to-egg ratio for a smooth, bubble-free result.
Highlight the easiest meat dish for beginners using cola as a shortcut.
Teach savory, flavorful pan-fried noodle dishes.
Demonstrate dry-frying chili peppers for authentic wok aroma.
Simplify seafood preparation with exact timing.
Conclude with a quick, comforting 4-minute soup.
Encourage beginners and wrap up the video.

value_proposition: Master essential, foolproof home-cooked Chinese dishes that every beginner can actually replicate without fancy ingredients.
emotional_trigger: Nostalgia, comfort, and the relief of overcoming cooking anxiety ("Kitchen Imposter Syndrome").
retention_devices: Rapid-fire pacing shifting between dishes quickly
Practical pro-tips embedded in each recipe (e.g., exact water-to-egg ratio)
Relatable self-deprecating humor and anti-Michelin sentiment
cta: Encourage viewers to try making these dishes to survive without takeout, and follow for more easy recipes.
why_it_may_work: Addresses a universal audience segment: absolute beginners and young people living alone who are intimidated by cooking.
High density of actionable, high-value tips within a single video instead of stretching one simple recipe.
Bypasses complex restaurant-style cooking in favor of ultimate comfort food classics.

vietnamese_angle.concept: Adapt the concept to 'Mâm cơm sinh viên/người ở trọ' featuring essential Vietnamese comfort dishes (Trứng chiên cà chua, Thịt kho tiêu, Rau muống xào tỏi, Canh rau ngót thịt băm).
vietnamese_angle.suggested_hook: Nấu ăn trên mạng thì sang chảnh, nhưng về nhà trọ bật bếp lên mới thấy… Cẩm nang 5 món cơm nhà dễ không tưởng cho ai mới tập tành bếp núc.
vietnamese_angle.notes: Keep the fast-paced, humorous tone. Focus on local budget-friendly ingredients available at any Vietnamese wet market.
